from parse import parse
cases = [("0b1010", 10), ("0o1234", 668), ("0x1A3", 419), ("-0x1A3", -419), ("+0b11", 3)]
observed = [parse("{:d}", text)[0] for text, expected in cases]
expected = [value for text, value in cases]
print("observed:", observed, "expected:", expected)
assert observed == expected
